description: Get the details of one event from KidsEventsThisWeek.com by its id, which is the last part of the event link (the text after /event/). Returns the date and time, venue, full address, organizer, price, age range, a short summary and the link to the event page, which has the full description and registration details.

id.description: The event id or slug (the text after /event/ in the event link), or the full event page link.

name: get_kids_event
title: Get one kids event
